description: Collect Domain.com.au sale, rent and sold listings, listing details, agent profiles and agency profiles. No cookies, logins or API keys are required.

agencyUrls.description: Domain agency profile URLs, for example https://www.domain.com.au/real-estate-agencies/raywhiteoakleigh-12122/
agencyUrls.title: Agency profile URLs (mode=agencies)

agentUrls.description: Domain agent profile URLs, for example https://www.domain.com.au/real-estate-agent/david-hua-1895120
agentUrls.title: Agent profile URLs (mode=agents)

excludeUnderOffer.description: Hide listings marked under offer or under contract.
excludeUnderOffer.title: Exclude under-offer listings

includeProjectListings.description: Include individual off-the-plan / new-development units that Domain shows in project cards. Off by default so results contain standard listings.
includeProjectListings.title: Include off-the-plan units

includeSurroundingSuburbs.description: When searching a suburb, include nearby suburbs as Domain does by default. Turn off to keep results inside the exact location.
includeSurroundingSuburbs.title: Include surrounding suburbs

keywords.description: Optional free-text keywords matched inside listing descriptions (for example 'pool' or 'waterfront').
keywords.title: Keywords

listingType.description: Sale, rent or recently sold listings.
listingType.title: Listing type (mode=search)

locations.description: Suburbs, postcodes, regions or Domain location slugs. Examples: 'Bondi Beach NSW 2026', 'bondi-beach-nsw-2026', 'sydney-region-nsw', '2000'.
locations.title: Locations (mode=search)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to collect per run.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPages.description: Maximum search-result pages to visit per URL. Domain caps region searches at 50 pages (about 1,000 listings), so split by suburb for deeper coverage.
maxPages.title: Max result pages per search URL

maxPrice.description: Optional maximum price in whole Australian dollars. For rentals this is the weekly rent.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (AUD)

minPrice.description: Optional minimum price in whole Australian dollars. For rentals this is the weekly rent.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (AUD)

mode.description: What to collect. 'search' builds a Domain search from locations + filters. 'urls' accepts any Domain search, listing, agent or agency URL. 'agents' and 'agencies' take profile URLs.
mode.title: Mode

propertyTypes.description: Optional property-type filter. Leave empty for all types.
propertyTypes.title: Property types

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy override. Leave off: the actor automatically uses the right Apify proxy for Domain's anti-bot layer.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

scrapeDetails.description: Open each search result's detail page for agent phone/email, description, floor plans, schools, inspection and auction details. Adds one request per listing.
scrapeDetails.title: Fetch listing detail pages

searchUrls.description: Domain.com.au search URLs, listing URLs, agent profile URLs or agency profile URLs. Search URLs support all of Domain's own filter query parameters.
searchUrls.title: Domain URLs (legacy / mode=urls)

sort.description: Result ordering. 'default' keeps Domain's featured order.
sort.title: Sort order (mode=search)

title: Domain.com.au Scraper Input
